attribution: Património Cultural, I.P. · Endovélico / Portal do Arqueólogo / official GeoPortal
method: Exact parish polygon clipping of the official public map points, joined by CNS to the complete single-page public parish search. Coordinates are the published map geometry; no independent location accuracy is claimed.
limitations: A dated public snapshot, not a complete archaeological survey or a novelty verdict. Public portal and map can differ; unlocated records are retained without invented markers.
A record point is a reference location, not a site boundary, an exclusion zone or a precise archaeological feature outline. Nearby or overlapping evidence can belong to an existing record.
Check the live Endovélico record, bibliography, published maps and reports before considering novelty. Absence from this snapshot does not prove a candidate is new.

Only public anonymous map/search facts are used. No authenticated coordinates, reports, photographs or descriptive texts are republished. No explicit reuse licence was stated in the ArcGIS item metadata at retrieval; credit is retained and no open licence is asserted.
